content.comment_body: Announcement: A web editor is now available, allowing users to control individual logic modules using smartphones, tablets, or computers.

analysis.insight_summary: This thread provides an announcement about a new web editor for managing logic modules across multiple device types. There is no user feedback or reported problems, and no discussion of user experience issues.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the product to offer a straightforward way to create and manage custom web pages on various devices for controlling logic modules.
